No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Newton printed the hymn under Proverbs 8:34–35. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

34Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway. 35For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD. PROVERBS 8:34–35 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PROVERBS 8
Approach my soul to Wisdom’s gates While it is called today; No one who watches there and waits Shall e’er be turned away. STANZA III
